subject.title: fix(agents): keep attempts running after auth and MCP fallback failures

question: When configured bundle MCP startup or materialization fails, should the embedded attempt continue without all MCP tools, continue only for explicitly optional MCP dependencies, or fail the attempt?
rationale: Source and tests can verify the catch behavior, but they cannot decide whether silently removing configured tools is the intended product contract for every bundle MCP failure.

options.title: Optional-only fallback
options.body: Continue only when the failed MCP dependency is explicitly classified as optional, while required configured MCP failures remain terminal.

options.title: Always continue
options.body: Accept core-tools-only continuation for every non-abort bundle MCP startup or materialization failure, with visible redacted diagnostics.

options.title: Keep fail-closed
options.body: Retain the current terminal behavior and improve diagnostics or doctor/probe guidance rather than dropping configured MCP tools.

recommendation.title: Optional-only fallback
recommendation.body: Continue only when the failed MCP dependency is explicitly classified as optional, while required configured MCP failures remain terminal.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes agents and subagents ownership to this person, and this decision sets embedded-attempt failure semantics.
